title: Iran's president at 21st Shahid Rajaei festival in Tehran:
text:
Iran's president at 21st Shahid Rajaei festival in Tehran:"

""

""
"Masoud Pezeshkian, Iran's President: "These enemies will not stop their cowardly terror; they either create division within the country and put us against one another so that we terrorize each other according to the plans they have drawn, or, when they lose hope in those plans, they incite direct attacks among Islamic countries. We are determined to emerge from these pressures and problems with honor and dignity, with your help and that of our dear people, and this will certainly happen.
